definitions.explanation: A device that counts the number of steps a person takes. Originally a standalone device, now commonly a feature in smartphones and smartwatches.

examples.japanese: {万歩計|まんぽけい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{歩数|ほすう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記録|きろく}している→記録する：25341_kirokusuru⟧。
examples.english: I'm recording my steps with a pedometer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{万歩計|まんぽけい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一万歩|いちまんぽ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}えた→超える：01942_koeru⟧。
examples.english: Today my pedometer went over ten thousand steps.

examples.japanese: ⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{万歩計|まんぽけい}⟦アプリ→アプリ：04722_apuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{運動量|うんどうりょう}→運動量：24918_undouryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{管理|かんり}している→管理する：21910_kanrisuru⟧。
examples.english: I use a pedometer app on my phone to track my daily exercise.

notes:
Composed of {万歩|まんぽ} (ten thousand steps) + ⟦{計|けい}→計：02691_kei⟧ (meter, gauge). The name references the popular health guideline of walking {一万歩|いちまんぽ} (10,000 steps) per day.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {万歩計|まんぽけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to wear a pedometer
- {万歩計|まんぽけい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{計|はか}る→計る：28292_hakaru⟧: to measure with a pedometer
- {万歩計|まんぽけい}⟦アプリ→アプリ：04722_apuri⟧: pedometer app

CULTURAL NOTE:
The 10,000 steps per day guideline actually originated in Japan in the 1960s with the marketing of a pedometer called {万歩計|まんぽけい} (literally 'ten-thousand-step meter'). The name itself helped popularize the 10,000-step goal worldwide. Today, ⟦{歩数計|ほすうけい}→歩数計：17072_hosuukei⟧ is the more technically precise term, but {万歩計|まんぽけい} remains far more commonly used in everyday speech.
